description: Full-scale replica built for the film 聯合艦隊司令長官 山本五十六; displayed at Misawa until 2020-11-08 then given to this museum; the fuselage alone was shown at the Tomoa community centre by Tomobe station from mid-November 2020 and moved to the museum in spring 2022; on public display in an exhibition store near the underground command post since 2022-06-25
aliases: A6M2; 零式艦上戦闘機21型
museum_name: Tsukuba Naval Air Group Memorial Museum
